title: Token Launch
summary: ERC-20 with permit and a supply cap
description: An 18-decimal ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit and burning. Supply is fixed by default; set a higher max supply to let the owner mint later, up to a lifetime cap.
prompts: Launch a token called MOON with a fixed supply of one million
Create an ERC-20 for my community that I can mint more of later
Deploy a governance token on my L1

main.description: Chain the token is issued on

params.name: initialSupply
params.description: Supply minted at deployment, in base units (18 decimals). The default is 1,000,000 tokens.

params.name: maxSupply
params.description: Lifetime issuance cap in base units. Equal to initialSupply means a fixed supply.

params.name: owner
params.description: May mint up to the cap

prerequisites: Native gas on the target chain for the signer

contracts.name: LaunchToken
contracts.description: ERC-20 with permit, burn, and a lifetime minting cap

checks.description: The initial supply went to the initial holder

review: The owner is the builder's address, passed in the constructor, so no ownership transfer is needed.
maxSupply is at least initialSupply; for a fixed supply they are equal and mint always reverts.
Amounts are in base units with 18 decimals: 1 token is 1000000000000000000.

frontend.summary: A token home page: what the token is, your balance, sending it to someone, and adding it to your wallet.
audience: Holders and community members of the token
The project team, who mint new supply
journeys: Understand the token: name, symbol, total and maximum supply, with a bar showing how much has been minted.
See your balance and share of supply ('You hold 1,250 MOON, 0.4% of supply').
Send to someone: address, amount with Max, 'Send 10 MOON', then a confirmation.
One click to 'Add MOON to your wallet'.
Team area, shown only to the owner: mint, with the remaining mintable amount.
flows: Show totalSupply, maxSupply and remainingMintable formatted with 18 decimals.
Transfers use transfer(to, amount). For spending by contracts, prefer permit signatures over approve.
Show the mint panel only when the connected wallet equals owner().
